candidates.question: What is the definition of a "large prime factor" in the context of this function?
candidates.answer: It specifically means the LARGEST prime factor of n (the maximum j <= n such that j divides n and j is prime) -- not merely "a prime factor that is large" in some subjective sense.
candidates.prompt:

    """Return a large prime factor of n. Assume n > 1 and is not a prime.
    """

Clarification: It specifically means the LARGEST prime factor of n (the maximum j <= n such that j divides n and j is prime) -- not merely "a prime factor that is large" in some subjective sense.
